syllabus_topics: Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs): examples of solvable first-order ODEs, integrating factors
Existence, uniqueness, and continuous dependence of solutions for systems of first-order ODEs
Laplace transform and applications to ODEs
Gauss and Stokes Theorems and introduction to Partial Differential Equations (PDEs): surfaces in R^3
Surface integrals of scalar and vector fields
Divergence and curl of vector fields
Derivation of continuity, wave, heat, Laplace, and Poisson differential equations
PDEs and Fourier series: linear first-order PDEs
Wave, heat, Laplace, and Poisson equations
Solutions of wave, heat, Laplace, and Poisson equations via separation of variables and Fourier series
assessment_rules: There will be 3 tests (45 minutes each) in weeks 6, 12, and 16, resulting in an arithmetic average T. There will be 1 exam (2 hours) resulting in a grade E, or alternatively, one of the tests can be improved on that date. If at most 1 test is submitted and the exam is not submitted, the final grade will be "NA" (Not Assessed). Otherwise, if the maximum of T and E is less than 9.5, the final grade will be "RE" (Failed); otherwise, the final grade will be the maximum of T and E. Enrollment in each assessment is mandatory. No calculation aids or consultation materials are allowed. Special exam period will consist of a 2-hour test, counting 100% for the final grade.
